process_mention_data: process mention samples into padded context and candidate token ID tensors for entity linking
get_context_representation_single_mentio: tokenize a single mention with left and right context into fixed-length BERT input IDs
get_context_representation_multiple_ment: tokenize multiple mentions with separate left and right context strings into fixed-length BERT input IDs
get_candidate_representation: tokenize a candidate entity description with optional title into fixed-length BERT input IDs
select_field_with_padding: extract a nested field from a list of dicts and pad all entries to the maximum length
